proof_audit.nash: v13-c06-nash: passed. Pure values have a finite maximum; a convex average equals it exactly on maximizing support. The mixed-strategy product is compact convex and each best-reply value a nonempty compact simplex. Passing all finite payoff inequalities to limits proves the closed graph. Accepted C04 supplies Kakutani without using Nash circularly. No pure-equilibrium or convergence inference.
proof_audit.perfection: v13-c06-perfection: passed. Positive floors with sum below one produce an affine simplex, so constrained existence applies. Approximate every unperturbed pure deviation by a feasible perturbed vertex before taking limits. Finitely many positive limiting support masses exceed their vanishing floors on one common tail. Reverse floors equal tremble mass off support and min(half-mass,1/k) on support: positive, sum below one, vanishing, with all discretionary probability on best actions. Full mixing gives positive weight to the strict mixed-dominance witness. Strict pure and fully mixed Nash are sufficient for perfection; neither uniqueness nor an extensive-form theorem follows.
proof_audit.bayesian: v13-c06-bayesian: passed. Positive own marginals define the conditional ratios; joint cells may be zero. The finite type-agent game has the displayed conditional payoffs; other own-type agents are mutually unrealized. Independent plan draws have the same realized typewise marginals. Ex ante/interim equivalence uses positive own-type weights; a null type requires omission or added beliefs. Both correlated priors preserve marginals but change the actual typewise incentives.
proof_audit.correlated: v13-c06-correlated: passed. Single-recommendation rules isolate each unnormalized inequality; summing covers all deterministic rules and nonnegative kernels cover randomized rules. Null recommendations are vacuous. Product factorization and support establish CE iff Nash for product laws, hence nonemptiness; linearity gives convexity. Both welfare bounds have strictly positive dual weights and unique binding equalities. Private versus fully public signals and independent replacement have different incentive tests.
proof_audit.coarse: v13-c06-coarse: passed. Summing pairwise CE terms gives every fixed-target CCE comparison. With at most two actions, exactly one nonzero recommendation term remains, proving equality of the concepts. For the stated three-action family the following, fixed-deviation and cyclic-deviation payoffs are affine in lambda; CCE holds throughout and CE only at zero. This is a complete family result, not a classification of all game equilibria or a learning theorem.
proof_audit.support_completeness: Cases1–5 and ex1,3,6–9: passed. Every binary support cell is considered, including the weak game’s full boundary edges. Dominance excludes every alternative perfect limit, beyond one uniform-floor path. The entry model’s five response regions and both boundary intervals exhaust its probability domain and yield exactly five typewise BNE. Original/changed CE welfare uniqueness follows a global nonnegative linear certificate and equality conditions, not a grid.
